oneOptionalFeasibleExperiment.name: Phase-and-direction primitive-work decomposition of the existing retained native cache corpus
oneOptionalFeasibleExperiment.hypothesis: Within the eight retained SPN-142 32-state cache pairs, a structural group's extra native work is located in unsupported sequential composition tails, rather than publication endpoints or qualification traversal. This is a hypothesis about those retained shapes, not about the missing B/C failing caches.
oneOptionalFeasibleExperiment.whyNotAnUnchangedRerun: Existing tests already compare whole-pair primitive counts and exact publication. The only new discriminating output would be attribution by native phase and forward/inverse fold, plus qualification traversal versus unsupported-tail work. If that decomposition cannot be collected without changing the native operation order, stop rather than merely rerun existing assertions.
inputs: The exact eight losslessly encoded history/collaboration pairs in docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-142/native-caches.json.gz; independently verify decompressed SHA-256 714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8 and count8 before execution.

The actual pinned Docs ES/CJS manager regions, validated through the existing complete-file hash guards. Compare exact upstream original and exact current-C patched output; do not introduce a candidate optimization.

The existing manager-fixture and measuredFlush mechanisms in scripts/dependencies/patch-univer-docs.test.ts. Keep original distinct history/collaboration arrays, native output ownership, synchronous endpoint order and full metadata. A diagnostic wrapper would live outside the repository and would not become a new test or production path.
oneOptionalFeasibleExperiment.finiteCount: 8 captured pairs x2 supported build formats x2 exact versions =32 paired flush executions, once each, serial, fixed order. No warmup/success-seeking repetition, new generated cases or expanded input matrix.
requiredData: Source/input/helper/runtime hashes and versions; explicit diagnostic instrumentation identity; all32 executions including failures.

Per history/collaboration phase and forward/inverse fold: TextX compose calls, action-iterator visits, body slices, clone visits/allocations; qualification predicate/traversal counts; admitted prefix lengths and unchanged unsupported-tail call positions.
Complete raw native outputs, own undefined properties, paragraph IDs/styles, input ownership/unchanged-state shape, intermediate publication/cache order, exceptions, and final queue state.
Endpoint counts, whether counters themselves changed the call graph, and bounded cleanup/exit result. Wall time is only a resource receipt; it is not compared with browser latency budgets.
oneOptionalFeasibleExperiment.decisionRule: A shape-specific deterministic work difference is established only if the measured extra work is localized to a particular unchanged native fold/qualification path and both versions preserve complete outputs and publication semantics. The eight samples define this claim's entire domain. A high operation count does not establish that this work caused either historical >100ms event, and a low count does not prove a runtime pause.
stopConditions: Any source/input identity mismatch, native output/ownership/order difference, incomplete observation, counter failure, process error, resource cap or missing required data stops the experiment and is retained.

If all32 executions finish, stop regardless of whether a useful difference appears. No mutation, parameter search, new cache capture, additional repetition or production optimization follows automatically.
If the proposed per-fold decomposition would itself require an unbounded instrumentation project or altered manager semantics, do not execute; report the capability checkpoint as inconclusive.
oneOptionalFeasibleExperiment.cleanup: Use a private temporary directory and one process. In finally blocks dispose the native manager and subscriptions and restore any temporary core-method counter wrappers. Reap the owned process. Retain compact protocol/results/source hashes outside the repo, then remove only the private temporary harness/input copies. No refs, production files, caches, unrelated worktrees or credentials are touched.
oneOptionalFeasibleExperiment.recommendation: Optional hypothesis pruning only. Do not run it solely to obtain a new green result: most semantic/count assertions already exist, and a result cannot remove the need for matching full-app evidence.

staticStorybookAssessment.nativeEditors: src/ui/redesign/NativeEditors.tsx and its story explicitly omit collaboration, accounts and persistence, and do not install boundDocHistory.
staticStorybookAssessment.docMobile: web/DocMobile.stories.tsx uses a local production-preset fixture with fixture save/connection labels; live persistence is explicitly owned by Playwright.
staticStorybookAssessment.syncNative: web/SyncNative.stories.tsx uses a real client with send:()=>{} and deliberately unacknowledged pending edits for drawing inspection. It is not the responsiveness fixture.
staticStorybookAssessment.conclusion: These are valid visual/native-component environments, but not the C full-app sustained-typing contract. Injecting a capacity policy, accounts or synchronization would create a new diagnostic fixture. It could help identify a renderer or native-shape issue, but cannot be represented as the original workload, acceptance or historical-tail attribution. No Storybook run is recommended for this question.

requiredExternalCapabilityForDirectAttri.minimum: An authorized runner capable of starting the unchanged real app under its required workspace lease, or a reviewed one-shot diagnostic workflow callable through a legitimate authorized capability. Merely gaining a dispatch button is insufficient without a reviewed diagnostic protocol and evidence collection.
requiredExternalCapabilityForDirectAttri.dataNeeded: A new full-workload event with an aligned outer-pair and native-phase timeline, directly attributable CPU/runtime trace spanning the event, lossless before-flush history/collaboration state shape, source/browser/throttle identity and exact content/selection/undo/access/cleanup results. Preserve observer overhead and mark any instrumented run diagnostic, not acceptance.
requiredExternalCapabilityForDirectAttri.finiteProtocolBoundary: Preregister one existing mobile2086-input diagnostic sample, one attempt,4x throttle, unchanged data/permissions/policy and budgets, bounded observer buffers, no automatic retries. If it does not produce a comparable interval or evidence is incomplete, conclude inconclusive and stop; do not expand into repeat-until-slow or repeat-until-green collection.
requiredExternalCapabilityForDirectAttri.limitation: Because the original B/C failing caches and traces are absent, even a later reproducer must be described as a new observed event with matching conditions, not the recovered historical cause. A demonstrated deterministic source defect plus controls can support a repair, but new unchanged full-app first-attempt acceptance remains necessary afterward.
